feat(window): show an interactive session bar beside its terminal (#975)

* feat(window): show an interactive session bar docked or inset beside its terminal

* test(window): verify repeated tmux hook edits preserve the reservation

* fix(window): retain crash cleanup when a local tmux hook shadows the global one

* fix(window): follow visible attachments and retire stale inset reservations and controls

* fix(window): stop restarting a follower whose source pane closed

* fix(window): recover inset when its menu fits again without taking over the statusline

* fix(window): recognize an ended tmux server and constrain measurement subscribers

* style(window): format subscription interest types

* feat(window): default to inset and place padded terminal grids
